issue.title: Issue this invoice?
issue.description: This approves it and writes it to the books: accounts receivable, sales and tax. It cannot be edited after it is issued.

approve.title: Approve this bill?
approve.description: This writes it to the books: raw material stock, input tax and accounts payable. It cannot be edited after it is approved.

cancel.title: Cancel this document?
cancel.description: It stays in the list as cancelled. If it was issued the entry in the books is reversed, and the delivery note (goods receipt) can be used again.

revert.title: Go back to the previous status?
revert.description: Use this to correct a wrong click. The reason is kept in the history.

confirmMoney.title: Confirm this payment?
confirmMoney.description: The money is booked now: the invoice (bill) becomes partly paid or paid and the entry is written to the books.

cancelMoney.title: Cancel this payment?
cancelMoney.description: A confirmed payment is reversed in the books and the amount is open again on the invoice (bill).

post.title: Post this entry?
post.description: A posted entry cannot be edited. A mistake is corrected with a reversing entry.

reverse.title: Reverse this entry?
reverse.description: A new entry with debit and credit swapped is written, and this one is marked as reversed.

errors.INVALID_STATUS: This is not possible in the current status.
errors.CONFIRM_INVALID: It cannot be confirmed as it is: the amount is more than the balance now.
errors.ACCOUNT_ROLE_MISSING: An account for this is missing in the Accounting master.
errors.ALREADY_USED: This already has an invoice or a bill.
